replies.author: izjust4fun
replies.body:
Hey Toby,

I've decided to deny your appeal. You could've just reported him for doing that instead of lashing out on him, you also said it a few more times than twice.. and you've been punished plenty of times in the past for similar offences!  Hopefully you'll learn your lesson, please follow the rules next time you come back onto the server! https://avicus.net/rules
